unreleased_status_preservation: NOT RUN. No existing portal or pharmacy endpoint sets a sold released layer back to UNRELEASED, and quantities were not written with SQL.
damaged_status_preservation: NOT RUN. No existing service writes DAMAGED, and this stage does not add that workflow.
tenant_capability_cache: NOT RUN. It requires the Pharmacy acceptance register, which was not launched while the inventory acceptance session is active.
offline_and_header_states: NOT RUN. Those states are produced by the register session, not by the Business Pro portal.
double_click_charge: NOT RUN. It requires the Windows register.
grocery_offline_sync: NOT RUN. It requires the Windows register. The grocery customer return in the portal was run separately.
revoked_pharmacist_ui: NOT RUN. Revocation was not repeated on the register in this stage.
natural_person_and_licence: NOT RUN. Those checks are outside the application-account model and were not added.
